2014_spells.bane.fullDescription: Using 1 action, up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
